name: nat-history-large-archive-search
description: native-host.ts:1353 native loaded history extracts only early page hits and lookahead from a large archive: 4096 archived HIST_NEEDLE messages across two windows are searched ten at a time (newest first, the visible match skipped), the cursor continues, and the oldest entry is still found. (The upstream assertion that at most 11 archived records were extracted counts property reads in the host process: Go layer, see coverage.)
